This directory holds the store-v1 initial-schema fixture (20261015000001_store_v1_initial.sql), the parity target for the embedded initial migration checked by TestStoreV1FixtureMatchesEmbeddedSchemaMinusOmittedObjects in internal/db/store_v1_schema_test.go. The invalid `ListNewFiles` query (a nonexistent `files.is_new` column, no callers) was removed together with the regenerated DB files as part of the H4 sqlc update.
